name: core-skills
description: Project-agnostic catalog skills bundled into one installable plugin. Each skill reads .claude/project-context.md for any project-specific facts it needs. Currently: install, catchup, worktree, commit, fix-bug, implement-plan, newbranch, next, plan-feature, pr, review-branch, review-mcp-descriptions, shepard, sync-worktrees, task-writer (with the bug-fix-verifier, runtime-integrity-reviewer, precedent-reviewer, docs-accuracy-reviewer, plan-reviewer, and surface-reviewer agents).
